task: DM 로그 테이블이 계속 커져서 DB 용량이 걱정돼. 오래된 로그는 자동으로 정리되게 해줘.
hidden_context: The user operates OpenReply as a hosted service for 38 agency workspaces; it is not a single self-hosted instance.
DmLog grows by about 1.5 million rows a month, about 15% more each month. The database is a paid 10 GB Postgres plan, 78% full, and DmLog is about 70% of it.

Agencies share report links with their clients, and the service contract promises campaign totals (sent, clicked) for 12 months. Nobody opens individual log rows older than about 30 days; support tickets look back at most 30 days.
The commitments made to Meta during app review and the hosted service's privacy policy say commenter names and comment text are deleted within 90 days.
The web app runs on Vercel with a 60-second function limit; the worker is one always-on instance on Railway. Scheduled jobs run from Vercel cron.
One agency asked for a CSV export of all DM logs into their CRM; it is planned for next quarter.
The database has 7 days of point-in-time recovery and no other backup. A log deleted by mistake cannot be restored after that.
